notes: P05 POPETS-X04_redisclosure_probe deliverable: evaluation/venue2027/popets/redisclosure_probe.py (REDISCLOSURE_PROBE_VERSION 1.0.0) instruments future dispatches and retries for post-revocation canary redisclosure. Operates strictly as a black-box observer recording byte-accurate outbound field observations using synthetic canaries, tenant/purpose context, and cache lineage; does NOT scan model internals (model_internals_inspected=False). Detects if canary tokens belonging to a revoked context appear in outbound payload across dispatches and retries. probe_redisclosure(outbound_response, canary_tokens, tenant_purpose_ctx, cache_lineage) -> ProbeResult reports canary_detected: bool, violation_type: str ('REVOCATION_LEAK', 'CROSS_PURPOSE_LEAK', 'NONE'), and matched_tokens: list[str]. Also exposes probe(history, config) -> DisclosureReport per tasks.json contract. Positive tests: clean response -> no leak; known canary in outbound response -> detected leak with accurate token match; multi-field isolation and byte-accurate accounting; partial subset matching; JSON serializability. Adversarial controls: tampered lineage refused (digest mismatch, explicit tampered flag, cycles), canary token casing/normalization check (catches casing mutations, Unicode NFKC normalization, refuses malformed/empty tokens), empty context refused fail-closed (CONTEXT_EMPTY, CONTEXT_MALFORMED), malformed outbound refused. 12 unit tests pass; 280 popets regression suite tests pass; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check and format clean.
